results.rationale: Consistency: the white background, gray fluted column design, lighting and receding arrangement remain, but the retained columns are enlarged within the frame, changing the margins. Instruction: the count falls from eight to seven; the expected result is exactly five columns, so most of the required reduction remains undone. Quality: satisfactory structure, natural shading, clean surfaces and intact capitals and bases; no noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: the blue three-by-three diagram remains recognizable, but the grid and symbols are vertically compressed and moved upward; the middle-row center square now masks the circle segment and the right square touches the circle instead of sitting separately below it. Instruction: the bottom-right question mark remains; the expected shape was a triangle with a blue circle on its bottom edge, and no such replacement appears. Knowledge: the supplied triangle-and-circle outcome is absent. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the diagram is legible and structurally coherent, with a small imperfection in slightly uneven, mottled outlines; shapes remain distinct.
